staticFrame.alt: Dark precision sound foundry with an empty specimen chamber, five processing rails, and a circular render press.

scenes.label: 01 / Specimen chamber
scenes.heading: A song enters whole.
scenes.narration: One source waveform enters the machine on the same 214.024-second clock used by every later stem.

scenes.label: 02 / Separation gantry
scenes.heading: One signal becomes five connected lanes.
scenes.narration: The real export separates vocals, backing vocals, drums, bass, and other without pretending these parts came from different timelines.

scenes.label: 03 / Analysis scanner
scenes.heading: Structure appears without changing the audio.
scenes.narration: Real BPM, key, downbeats, and twelve detected sections move across the same shared envelope data.

scenes.label: 04 / Arrangement deck
scenes.heading: The five lanes become a readable arrangement.
scenes.narration: Section boundaries turn a long signal into material that can be reasoned about without inventing a miniature editor.

scenes.label: 05 / Mix chamber
scenes.heading: Relative levels remain visible as the lanes converge.
scenes.narration: All six envelopes use one normalization scale, preserving the real relationship between source and stems.

scenes.label: 06 / Render press
scenes.heading: Five lanes resolve into one representation.
scenes.narration: The visual closes the product loop without claiming to be a working mixer or shipping any audio bytes.

scenes.label: 07 / Measurement and boundary
scenes.heading: The demonstration stops where the evidence stops.
scenes.narration: No publishable retry trace is visualized, audio remains withheld, and the separation benchmark keeps its one-input denominator.

scenes.label: 08 / Deep-dive handoff
scenes.heading: The world ends. The engineering record begins.
scenes.narration: The complete paper case study carries the architecture, research, failures, measurements, limitations, and sources.
